title: Quenched Brazilian Tofu Bake
description: A rich, crumbly vegan bake that marries tofu with a red wine reduction for a comforting Brazilian-inspired dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius and grease a medium baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, red wine, and vegetable broth, then let the mixture simmer for five minutes to reduce slightly.
In a bowl, toss the tofu cubes with breadcrumbs, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper.
Add the tofu to the skillet, stir gently to coat, and cook for three minutes until the edges brown.
Transfer the tofu and sauce mixture to the prepared baking dish and spread evenly.
Bake for twenty minutes until the top is crisp and the tofu is heated through.
